==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|partener}}, {{m|enm|partiner}}, alteration (due to {{cog|enm|part}}) of {{cog|enm|parcener}}, from {{der|en|fro|parçonier}}, {{m|fro|parçonneour|t=joint heir}} from {{m|fro|parçon|t=partition}}, from {{der|en|la|partītiōnem}}, singular accusative of {{m|la|partītiō|t=portion}}. The word may also represent {{cog|fro|part tenour|t=part holder}}. Compare also {{noncog|enm|partifere|t=partner}}, {{m|enm|partifelewe|t=partner}}. {{doublet|en|parcener}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɑːt.nə/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɑɹt.nɚ/|[ˈpɑɹʔ.nɚ]|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-partner.ogg|a=Southern California}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɐːt.nə/|a=AuE,NZ}}
* {{hyph|en|part|ner}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# Either of a [[pair]] of people or things that belong together.
# Someone who is [[associated]] with another in a [[common]] [[activity]] or [[interest]].
#: {{coi|en|business '''partner'''}}
#: {{coi|en|dance '''partner'''}}
#: {{coi|en|doubles '''partner'''}}
#: {{coi|en|speaking '''partner'''}}
#: {{coi|en|sex '''partner'''}}
## A member of a [[business]] or [[law]] [[partnership]].
## A [[spouse]] or other person with whom one shares a [[domestic]], [[romantic]]{{,}} or [[sexual]] bond.
##* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Amelia Gentleman|title=CPS includes ‘love-bombing’ in guidance on abusive partners prosecution|date=2023-04-23|url=https://www.theguardian.com/law/2023/apr/24/cps-includes-love-bombing-in-guidance-on-abusive-partners-prosecution|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251224032153/https://www.theguardian.com/law/2023/apr/24/cps-includes-love-bombing-in-guidance-on-abusive-partners-prosecution|passage=New guidance on how to prosecute abusive '''partners''' for controlling and coercive behaviour has highlighted the phenomenon of love-bombing, a tactic used by suspects to confuse victims and gain more control.}}
## Someone with whom one dances in a two-person dance.
##* {{RQ:Marshall Squire's Daughter|I
|passage=He tried to persuade Cicely to stay away from the ball-room for a fourth dance.{{...}}But she said she must go back, and when they joined the crowd again her '''partner''' was haled off with a frightened look to the royal circle, […].}}
## Someone with whom one plays on the same side in a game, such as [[card game]]s or [[doubles]] [[tennis]].
# {{lb|en|nautical}} One of the pieces of wood [[comprise|comprising]] the [[framework]] which strengthens the deck of a wooden ship around the holes through which the [[mast]] and other fittings pass.
# {{lb|en|Jamaica}} A group [[financial]] [[arrangement]] in which each member contributes a set amount of money over a set period.

* See also [[Thesaurus:spouse]]
